summary: An analyst request flagged transaction 3660108 on card C05061-K1 during an investigation into multi-card losses without shared devices. Investigation confirmed a burst of three unauthorized online product-C charges totaling $2,189.02 between 2017-01-12 and 2017-01-14. All three transactions were conducted from new devices (D009708 and D009709) operating behind an anonymous proxy. Peer analysis identified the identical operational signature across cards C07212-K2 and C11543-K2, with C07212-K2 linked to organized fraud ring 34603052. The activity was confirmed as card-not-present fraud using new devices, resulting in card blocking, case creation, cross-card monitoring, and regulatory reporting.
open_question: The individual fraudster identities and the initial compromise vector for card details across C05061-K1, C07212-K2, and C11543-K2 remain unconfirmed without merchant breach intelligence.
